description: This file contains functions and types related to Kubernetes API discovery aggregation, including converting aggregated discovery data into legacy formats, handling errors for stale group versions, and processing API resources and subresources for different API discovery versions.

classes.name: StaleGroupVersionError
classes.description: Error type representing a stale group version in discovery.

methods.name: SplitGroupsAndResources
methods.description: Transforms aggregated discovery data into separate API group list and resources map.

methods.name: convertAPIGroup
methods.description: Converts an aggregated APIGroupDiscovery to a legacy APIGroup and resources map.

methods.name: convertAPIGroupv2beta1
methods.description: Converts a v2beta1 aggregated APIGroupDiscovery to a legacy APIGroup and resources map.

methods.name: StaleGroupVersionError
methods.description: Error type indicating a stale group version.
